description: Traffic infringement notice payments is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Daily number of traffic infringement notice payments by service channel. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are customer service centre, licence, penalty infringement notices, reporting, service channel. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, txt. The portal shows 2025-07-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
